links.outcome: Unsafe LLM responses to eating disorder prompts with varying risk levels
links.effect: Specific linguistic cues in prompts increased the likelihood of unsafe responses. LLMs uncritically adapted to problematic and potentially dangerous user inputs. No numeric results reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We find, in consultation with clinical ED experts, that specific linguistic cues in prompts increase the likelihood of unsafe responses

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of how LLMs respond to simulated eating disorder queries and unsafe prompt cues, evaluating safety vulnerabilities rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
